## Setup

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
from IPython.display import HTML
```

```{python}
# load passport viewing data
passport = pd.read_csv("Data_Files/passport_viewing_data.csv")

# rename columns
passport = passport.rename(columns={
    "Content.Channel": "Series_Title",
    "Title": "Episode_Title",
    }
)
```

## Series Popularity

```{python}
# calculate total number of unique passport accounts
total_accounts = passport["UID"].nunique()

show_summary = (
    passport
    .groupby("Series_Title", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        Outreach=("UID", "nunique"),
        total_watch_time_seconds=("Time.Watched", "sum"),
        avg_show_completion=("Percent.Watched", "mean")
    )
)

# Calculate percent of all accounts that watched each show
show_summary["Outreach (%)"] = (
    show_summary["Outreach"] / total_accounts * 100
)

# Convert total watch time to hours
show_summary["Watch Time (Hrs)"] = (
    round((show_summary["total_watch_time_seconds"] / 3600), 2)
)

show_summary = show_summary.drop(columns=['total_watch_time_seconds'])

# Sort by outreach, highest first
show_summary = (
    show_summary
    .sort_values(
        ["Outreach", "Watch Time (Hrs)"],
        ascending=[False, False]
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Set column order
show_summary[
        [
            "Series_Title",
            "Outreach",
            "Outreach (%)",
            "Watch Time (Hrs)"
        ]
    ]

display(HTML(show_summary.to_html(index=False)))
```
